title: Three-dimensional scanning electron microscopy of maxillofacial biomaterials
authors: Pabst, A. M., Müller, W. E. G., & Ackermann, M. (2017). The British journal of oral & maxillofacial surgery, 55(7), 736–739.
supports: Pre-clinical study from the botiss maxgraft (processed human allograft) literature list — the product featured in it, which is not the same as the study being about the product, so check the design and the comparator before citing it as product evidence. Abstract, verbatim (no separate conclusion section): “Report on a method of 3-dimensional scanning electron microscopy (3D-SEM) to visualize maxillo-facial biomaterials. 3D visualization of mucoderm®, Mucograft®, and maxgraft®.” This records what the paper says, not what a rep may say: the sales wording still has to pass the claim tiers, and a study in one indication licenses nothing in another.
